biggest_catch: The advertised range is huge ($100-$1,500) — the high end is for doctors, executives, and B2B professionals; everyday consumers typically qualify for the lower end.
catches: Wide pay range; most consumer studies are at the lower end
Must pass screening for each study; signing up guarantees nothing
Profession-specific studies (e.g., audiologists) require the matching profession
Incentive paid via Tremendous after participation is confirmed
Spots are limited; scheduling closes as studies fill
